title: SafeScan Mobile App Mockup Design
description: An AI-powered food safety mobile application that scans ingredients to detect allergens, identify health risks, and recommend smarter food choices.
summary: A concept app that scans any ingredient list and flags allergens and health risks before you buy. I designed the end-to-end experience: AI scanning, risk dashboard, alerts, and smarter-swap suggestions. Mint-and-orange visuals with clear Safe / High / Low risk cues.
outcome: Scan anything, know what's safe instantly
highlights: AI scan flags allergens + risks with Safe / High / Low cues
Weekly scan dashboard with urgent risk alerts
Smarter-swap picks for every flagged product
